text: SICAM S8000 is a flexible, software‑based substation automation and control solution within the SICAM 8 platform. It supports modern, digitalized power systems by enabling modular architecture, efficient engineering, and resilient operation across a wide range of applications. With its open design and deployment flexibility, SICAM S8000 provides a solid foundation for scalable, secure, and future‑ready grid solutions.

text: Designed to grow with your system, SICAM S8000 expands connectivity, performance, and applications. Its flexibility supports changing energy needs, reduces hardware, and enables tailored solutions via SICAM SIAPP integration.
heading: Scalability and Adaptability

text: Deploy SICAM S8000 on prequalified IPCs or fully virtualized to achieve complete hardware independence. Choose the deployment model that fits your solutions and environment best.
heading: IPC & full virtualized solutions

text: Improve grid resilience with SICAM S8000. Its hardware‑independent, virtualized architecture decouples software from devices, enabling fast recovery, flexible scaling, and secure, future‑proof operation.
heading: Improved resilience

text: Virtual Test setups for IPC-based SICAM S8000 solutions

Create virtual test setups to validate behavior and performance early. Fully virtualized, scalable, and reproducible testbeds accelerate FATs, enable continuous testing, and reduce costs and engineering effort.

text: All‑in‑One configurations with SICAM S8000 combine RTU, HMI, control, and monitoring on a single runtime, enabling compact, cost‑efficient, and fully integrated substation automation and control.
heading: All-in-one configurations-compact substation automation

text: Built in cybersecurity for future-ready grids

SICAM S8000 protects substations with an enhanced configurable firewall, encrypted TLS communication, and role‑based access control. Compliance with IEC62443 and IEC62351 support secure, future‑ready grid operations.
heading: Built in cybersecurity for future-ready grids

text: The SICAM S8000 can be widely used by DSOs and TSOs as a substation automation system, station controller, RTU, gateway, and virtual SCADA frontend. SICAM S8000 supports primary and secondary substations, enables secure grid‑edge and cloud‑to‑SCADA integration, and provides a future‑proof replacement for legacy systems such as SICAM PAS.
